notes.semetey-1-2013:p0566:b003:l001: Opening repeats the command already stated on565; retained as a separate verse.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0566:b003:l004: Burut is the source's external designation for the Kyrgyz; not normalized away.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0566:b003:l008: Half of Beijing's realm and the promised khan's rule retained across8–9; no invented fixed number of kingdoms.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0566:b003:l010: Forty rope-length depth, binding both hands and gouging both eyes retained literally across10–16.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0566:b003:l023: Primary Yudakhin торчон means clad in mail. Iron ropes are retained with these surrounding warriors, not silently made into a net. Compare5664:10–11.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0566:b003:l025: канжарколчон retains epic dagger-handed warriors, not a generic troop name or omitted equipment.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0566:b003:l027: The cliff where geese circle and the protective mountain Manas in27–30 remain linked poetic images, not geographical claims.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0566:b004:l004: келме is the Islamic profession of faith recited with final wishes, not merely words.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0566:b004:l013: көйкашка denotes a renowned outstanding hero in this context, not shamelessness; printed Кабыдан leopard variant retained in meaning.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0566:b004:l015: Fly-like soul preserves the source's diminutive image for endangered life; dark tears are poetic distress.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0566:b004:l022: The destination of arrive-before-Almam is implicit in the preceding sacrifice/death speech; no new place or literal race supplied.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0566:b004:l024: Twin lamb and devouring one's twin in24–26 are retained as companion/loss imagery. No factual cannibalism asserted; longing follows the primary эрик- sense of missing someone.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0566:b004:l033: мыйзамдын күлү denotes autumn gossamer in the established dictionary formula. Together with ripening stalks, the temporal image is preserved rather than compressed into a moment.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0566:b004:l038: Primary Yudakhin олбуй-солбуй explicitly means alternating right and left, with whipping/spurring examples.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0567:b003:l004: Printed indented fragment5 belongs to this single verse; all original raw segments retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0567:b003:l014: жетигим rendered accomplished, distinct from жетим orphan; printed word unchanged.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0567:b003:l015: башы челек кан describes a blood-covered head in this formula, not an enlarged bucket-shaped head. Adjacent limp arms retain ambiguous pronoun reference rather than adding an explicit agent.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0567:b003:l026: ай далы is shoulder-blade anatomy; no lunar object added. Right knee in28 retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0567:b004:l003: The narrative reveals the preceding battle as Kanykei's memorial picture. Narrator's my mother retained; no invented transition or scene deleted.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0567:b004:l010: Piebald-headed steeds translates descriptive алабаш here, not a new single horse named Alabash for all forty men.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0567:b004:l019: Primary Yudakhin болжош I is sign/mark, including a guiding star comparison. Verse18 remains wholly unresolved, so its precise modifier is not supplied here.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0567:b004:l035: Bloody Neck and blood-drinker in35–36 are fierce epithets in the source; retained alongside the subsequent humiliation of camel herding.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0568:b003:l002: Кечээ rendered yesterday as printed; it can be a retrospective poetic past. The later twelve-year duration is not silently reconciled.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0568:b003:l011: Primary Yudakhin куу сакал explicitly white/gray beard. The phrase is a dismissive address in this context, not a claim of a dried or absent beard.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0568:b003:l023: Primary Yudakhin чубама quotes exact жалгыз малдын чубама as a path animals can pass only one at a time; not a missing animal or broken travel clause.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0568:b003:l036: Literal saline-ground reading of шор used in the simile of grouped camels; Yudakhin notes overlap with misfortune sense. No actual salt-feeding event asserted beyond the comparison.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0568:b004:l007: The boy's rhetorical question about sparing his life and subsequent wish to die are translated as literary grief; no method or action invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0568:b004:l010: чунагың is retained as affectionate address to the boy here, not an invented physical injury.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0568:b004:l019: Quail-like and currant-like eyes, whip-length tears, and ember eyes retained as consecutive poetic images.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0568:b004:l027: Primary Yudakhin каймал is a she-camel in her fifth year; female/age distinction retained. Herd mother/father labels remain as narrated.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0568:b004:l032: нар is a hybrid camel. The broad hump, black coloring and rear hump are retained without harmonizing zoological details.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0568:b004:l039: Primary Yudakhin окто I = нокто, halter; the missing initial n is a documented lexical variant, not a source emendation.
